sampling_method: Fixed-seed random sample of 30 distinct questions from 100-sample confirmatory cohort
review_type: Single-reviewer blinded analysis (inter-rater reliability omitted pending independent secondary rater)

Prompt-Correction.description: Standard prompt failed exact match; Concise prompt achieved exact match.

Prompt-Degradation.description: Standard prompt achieved exact match; Concise prompt failed exact match.

Persistent-Error.description: Both prompt conditions failed exact match.

Persistent-Success.description: Both prompt conditions achieved exact match.

Evidence Insufficiency.description: Evidence context lacked gold answer entity (model appropriately output 'Insufficient information').

Incomplete or Extended Entity.description: Model extracted correct entity along with additional valid list items or slightly different prepositional phrasing.

Factually Ungrounded / Misaligned Contex.description: Model extracted adjacent entity or conflated dates/entities from context.

Conversational Preamble Stripped.description: Gold entity was present in standard output, but full-sentence framing caused EM failure. Concise prompt emitted isolated entity.

Refusal Overcome by Direct Prompting.description: Standard prompt conservatively refused; concise prompt directly extracted valid entity.
